original_reference_provenance.finding: Historical Julia computes mathematically equivalent histogram/padding/scatter through a host prefix-scan roundtrip instead of native small/general GPU paths. Its expert_ids zero-fill and thread0 expert-label stores can overlap across warps, a source-observed potential race, not a measured historical failure. Named reference preserves original bytes, restores actual source small/general algorithm structure, uses explicit portable Blelloch scan instead of CUB, and keeps fill threads alive through barriers. These are P1 mapping/control-flow adaptations with output-equivalent intent.

mapping_adaptations: CUB1024 BlockScan to explicit shared Blelloch scan
Small fill-only threads remain alive through all3barriers
Scratch preallocated outside named pipeline timer, unlike original host wrapper
scope_limits: Canonicalization removes only irrelevant within-expert token ordering; all labels/padding/total/prefix endpoints remain exact.
Five fixed cases, singlemodeloffset0, nulltokenmask. Small invalid>=E expert IDs unmeasured.
Routing preprocessing only; downstream expert matrix multiplication/model quality unmeasured.
Only CUDA backend tested; generic Atomix usage is not a measured cross-backend portability result.
